primaryGDPAssembly.publisher: Maddison Project, University of Groningen / DataverseNL
primaryGDPAssembly.rights: Metadata CC-BY-4.0; workbook citation policy and underlying original source requirements retained. Native source sheets privately retained; no redistribution.
primaryGDPAssembly.unitProof: Native Notes sheet specifies real GDP per capita in2011$ and population mid-year in thousands. Frozen source-linked codebook explicitly defines GDP as international dollars in2011 prices, adjusted for inflation and living-cost differences, and identifies MPD2023.
primaryGDPAssembly.fixedRegion: EU27 exactly AUT BEL BGR HRV CYP CZE DNK EST FIN FRA DEU GRC HUN IRL ITA LVA LTU LUX MLT NLD POL PRT ROU SVK SVN ESP SWE; no UK or time-varying membership
primaryGDPAssembly.formula: For each original member-year: native gdppc * native populationThousands *1000; region=sum27 complete member products. Neither OWID population nor another GDP vintage is spliced in.

newExactAssembly.missingDefinition: All27 members ×2023/2024; both native gdppc and pop absent. Exact member/year/source-row/input cells retained in private result.
newExactAssembly.precisionDecision: The primary arithmetic and frozen GDP values are not byte-identical. Differences are preserved, not removed by a fitted offset, guessed float-storage conversion or relaxed acceptance tolerance. No substitution authorized.

primaryGDPAssembly.fullWindowDecision: No complete compatible2010-2024 regional P/GDP/primary-energy/fossil-industrial-CO2 input set. Training2010-2018 and holdout2019-2024 remain untouched; no shortened-window forecast or unchanged study rerun.

unchangedPhysicalDefinitions.GDP: Constant2011 international PPP dollars,not nominal or constant2021PPP; source-primary product uses its own population rather than substituting the frozen OWID population factor.
unchangedPhysicalDefinitions.energy: Frozen source primary_energy_consumption in TWh from the specified EI2025/EIA2026 release,not an interchangeable total-energy-supply measure. New UK quarterly electricity generation is a different denominator and never fills primary-energy cells.
unchangedPhysicalDefinitions.carbon: Frozen CO2 is annual fossil/industrial CO2 in Mt from GCB2025,excluding land-use change,not all-GHG CO2e. Industrial-process CO2 means C/E remains an accounting ratio,not a pure fuel emission factor.
unchangedPhysicalDefinitions.regionBoundary: A fixed ISO membership sum establishes an explicit GDP aggregation,not independent compatibility of every primary-energy/carbon national territory or international-bunker boundary. Those joint boundary reconciliations remain required before use.
